_comment: Generated by the CRE Cloud Solutions plugin (tools/flyer-layout/build-flyer-reference.php) from its own registry. Do not edit by hand: regenerate.

codes.E-FL-SHAPE: not a flyer layout document: `type` "crecs-flyer-layout", `version` 1, a `content` list and, when given, a `title` of one line of at most 120 characters; nothing else
codes.E-FL-ROOT: `content` is not exactly one `crecs_flyer` block, or one sits inside another block
codes.E-FL-REQUIRED: the header band or the footer band is missing
codes.E-FL-ONCE: a block that appears once (the flyer, the header band, the footer band) appears more often
codes.E-FL-LIMIT: more than 150 blocks, or nested more than 8 deep, or more than 2 logo blocks (each carries a whole image, which every page of its band prints again, and so does each attachment frame)
codes.E-FL-NODE: a block without its `id`, `elType`, `widgetType`, `settings` and `elements`, or with any other key
codes.E-FL-ID: an id that is not 4 to 16 letters or digits, or that two blocks share
codes.E-FL-BLOCK: a `widgetType` the flyer does not have
codes.E-FL-ELTYPE: an `elType` that is not the block's kind (`container` or `widget`)
codes.E-FL-WITHIN: a block directly inside a parent it does not allow
codes.E-FL-SETTING: a setting the block does not have
codes.E-FL-VALUE: a value outside its control's shape or range, or settings that do not go together: a row's column widths, a row's columns and gaps against the narrowest page, a logo's source and image, a fixed height against the padding and border inside it, a page's room between the bands
codes.E-FL-FONT: a font the flyer printer does not have
